Use case: style-transfer. Deliver ONE finished 1920x1080 landscape tactical videogame battle-screen concept, entire viewport, no presentation-board border, no caption outside UI. Image 1 is the current actual Godot screenshot of the original science-fantasy game A_star: use its camera, spatial composition, FOUR characters and visual scale, recognizable character identities, giant alien roots surrounding the ground, and HUD functionality as composition reference. Image 2 is ONLY a stylistic reference from another game; do not copy its characters, composition, logos, or mechanics.
Create a beautiful and very readable original A_star battlefield. Preserve flat ground on ONE gameplay elevation; point-topped hexes in an approximately 18 columns x12 rows logical frame, 94x78 pixels at target resolution, subtle lattice. All four figures MUST remain small game miniatures: engineer Tesla at (550,570), ivory bronze armoured spearman at (940,690), rusty biped gun-walker enemy at (1310,330), giant mantis enemy at (1310,570). Typical human visible height 82px, machine90px, mantis96px, max width120px at 1920x1080. No other troops or big foreground character. Feet centered on cells, compact thin HP bar below feet, muted blue team ring allies/red enemies. Air and free space around silhouettes. Existing giant roots border the entire clear battlefield; water beyond the left boundary, alien bone-white vegetation, rust-red technological remnants. Two small low impassable rocky mounds near (940,485) and (1035,545), not walkable height tiers.
Fixed comparison scenario: remove most of the baseline's demonstration hazard rings. Show exactly FOUR separated environmental patches: cyan electrical cracks centered(700,430), fire at(940,430), acid at(840,605), water at(1170,430). They are physical ground decals and short restrained effects, NOT portals. Keep empty centers readable under characters. Show faint blue reachable tiles near Tesla, and just one orange outer perimeter for ranged area; no orange outline on each tile. Golden selected-hex edge beneath Tesla. One small hover card positioned in free ground near(730,300), reading "ЭЛЕКТРИЧЕСТВО", "Состояние гекса", "3 раунда".
HUD content and placement preserve A_star: upper left compact active unit panel "ТЕСЛА", "10 / 10", "Движение: 5 / 5". At upper center-left a queue of exactly four tiny framed unit portraits. Upper right "Боевой лог", "РАУНД 01", settings gear. Bottom right an opaque compact action panel, 8 controls in two rows: "Движение", "Выстрел", "Лазер", "ЭМИ-граната", "Электромагнитный выстрел", "Электрическое поле", "Электротурель", "Защита". Icons should be easy to distinguish, no invented mana, AP, resources or counts of soldiers. Small line under defense: "Завершает ход". Clear Russian text, cream readable typography, good dark backing for all text. No huge hero portraits. Entire frame coherent with chosen style below. These are concept art UI panels, not a screenshot reproduction. Avoid muddy grey overall picture, avoid card-game layout, avoid cinematic closeup, photorealism, extreme bloom or overgrown impassable decorations in center.

directions.text: STYLE: Eador Genesis (the original 2D 2009 game, NOT Masters of the Broken World): a humble detailed old fantasy tactical board, finely stippled/pixel-sized hand-painted textures, quiet olive moss and dry ochre land, flat even daylight, warm black-brown crevices. Simple modeled but crisply cut miniatures, dark brown thin selective silhouette edge, pale ivory and cool turquoise metal highlights on people, strong recognizable contour. Terrain less contrast than units. Palette olive #58623A, soil #847453, warm deep shadow #292718, tarnished gold #B59A52, parchment #E4D7AB, accent cool blue #63B6C4. Give the alien-root environment this believable olive mossy Eador treatment. Ornamented but compact burgundy-brown inset HUD panels with antique gold bevels and tiny metal corners, pictorial painted icons. Tooltip has a parchment text area inside brown-and-gold frame. No full-height sidebar: translate its material language into the current A_star compact panels. NOT chunky modern pixel art, not thick cartoon outlines. The charm is lucid, modest, earthy tabletop illustration.

Preserve the existing Eador Genesis earthy olive old illustration art style and palette exactly. Do not redesign anything else.

directions.text: STYLE: Heroes of Might and Magic III Horn of the Abyss classic battle art. Palette #746544 earth, #41482D olive, #31251F shadow, #BC9A49 antique gold, #C5C5AD ivory, #668795 cool steel. Low visual noise under figures. Ornate old strategy-game HUD: carved dark wood and oxblood inset, gold fillets/beveled frames, substantial icon buttons, creamy small serif typography with clean readable numeric labels. Hover tooltip is a compact deep wine-red/gold framed information window. Do not import cavalry commanders at screen corners, stacks/unit-count badges, castle siege walls or any fantasy armies. Keep exactly original FOUR A_star small characters and the original near-top-down fixed camera, not HotA's low horizon. Classical sprite art with rich materials, not oil-painting brushstroke abstraction.

directions.text: STYLE: Songs of Conquest: exquisitely authored modern pixel art, deliberate visible pixel clusters, hue-shifted shadows, painterly composition through limited ramps; NOT blurry oil paint and NOT simply a pixel filter over a 3D render. Cool deep petrol-teal/blue-violet ambient shadows against warm amber edge lighting, desaturated moss ground, pale gold-ivory armour; controlled magical cyan and tiny orange sparks. Palette #202B3A, #425849, #748C67, #B58A4E, #E9D5A0, #66C7CD. Dark selective colored pixel contour on sprites, bright 1-pixel highlight clusters, small clean contact shadows, silhouettes distinct from local soil. Different pixel ramps for ground, units, effects; reduced microcontrast at ground. Alien roots and moss form a picturesque vignette; restrained atmosphere ONLY outside playable center. Use a painted-2D approximation of warm volumetric mood, without 3D terrain elevation or new shadow mechanics. Elegant dark plum/navy HUD with warm thin ivory/gold framing, fine geometric ornamental corners, crisp pictorial pixel icons, highly legible typography. Tooltip dark blue-plum, thin warm outline, clear header/body spacing; no parchment. Keep the same compact A_star HUD positions and four-portrait top queue, not SoC's long bottom queue. Strongly distinct from the two classical retro variants while preserving the same geometry, four small characters, four patches and mechanics.
